title: Your Lead Intake and Qualification System: Reliable, Easy to Maintain

sections.label: 1 - YOUR LEAD CAPTURE FLOW
sections.note: Your website form, an ad lead form or anything that can send a webhook posts here. Names, emails and phones are cleaned up first, and blank submissions stop before they cost an OpenAI call.

sections.label: 2 - QUALIFY EVERY LEAD WITH OPENAI
sections.note: OpenAI scores each lead against the qualification rules you write in plain English in Config, and says why in one sentence. A missing budget or timeline lowers the score instead of being guessed.

sections.label: 3 - ROUTE QUALIFIED LEADS TO THE RIGHT TEAM
sections.note: You list your teams and their inboxes once in Config. OpenAI picks the team, this step finds its inbox, and a lead it cannot place goes to your default inbox.

sections.label: 4 - YOUR LEAD STATUS TRACKER
sections.note: Every lead lands in one Google Sheet, qualified or not, with its score, team and reason. Your team moves the Status column on to Contacted, Booked, Won or Lost.

sections.label: 5 - YOUR REPORTING DASHBOARD
sections.note: Every morning the Dashboard tab is rebuilt from the tracker: leads today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days and all time, by source, team and status, and who is still waiting for first contact. The same numbers arrive by email.

sections.label: 6 - RELIABLE: IF ANYTHING BREAKS, YOU HEAR ABOUT IT
sections.note: Nothing fails quietly. Any failed step emails you the step, the error and a link to the run, and the lead waits in that run for a retry.

4 - OpenAI Scores the Lead Against Your Rules
nodes.notes: Your rules live in Config in plain English: change them there and the next lead is judged by them.

params.system_message: You qualify inbound leads for a business that sends each qualified lead to one of its teams. You receive one lead from the website or ad form, the business's own qualification rules, and its list of teams with what each team handles. Judge the lead only against those rules; never add criteria of your own. score is 0 to 100 for how closely the lead matches the rules. qualified is true only when the rules are met. team is one team name copied exactly from the list; if no team fits, or the lead is not qualified, return Unassigned. When a field the rules depend on is missing or vague (budget, timeline, what they need), do not guess it: lower the score, name the field in missing_info and say so in reason. Spam, sales pitches aimed at the business, job applications and test entries are not qualified, score 0, and reason says which one it is. reason is one plain sentence. summary is two sentences a team member can act on without opening the tracker. Use only facts written in the lead. Never promise the lead anything.
